text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa... Th-There's way more variety than 
I thought. What's this? Powder... Is this 
the kind you pat all over your body after 
a bath?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Wh-What should I do? I have no clue... 
But the store clerk looks busy, so I 
should try to manage on my own—)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey, Kitasan. Fancy seeing you in a 
place like this.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Nature-san...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'm just on my way back from shopping, 
but... wait. Why the troubled look?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Eh. ...W-Was it showing on my face?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, what's the matter? Come on, tell 
big sis Nature all about it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I just finished what I had to do anyway, 
so instead of Helpful Kitasan, let's have 
Helpful Nature-san step in for you.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Isn't that blush way too cute? Wait, 
is it cream? Doesn't it get uneven or 
what??

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Total breeze. I'm using Plabusno No. 7, 
but for you Jordan, No. 5 would prob look 
super good.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
For real? I'm gonna check it out ASAP 
today. Got TV interviewers coming 
tomorrow, so gotta get my face hyped up 
anyway~

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Makeup... I've always thought everyone 
looks so gorgeous all the time. M-Maybe I 
should try it too?)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I have an interview scheduled soon too, 
so... well, I thought I'd try putting on 
some makeup for once!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see. In that case, someone who's 
good at makeup like—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm so relieved though! With you here, 
Nature-san, it feels like having the 
strength of a hundred people!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Eh. No, wait, look...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Nature-san, you're always so calm, 
mature... and so dependable. Please help 
me out!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Looking at me with those sparkling 
eyes... geez... Ahahahaha...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—So that's the situation, help! When it 
comes to makeup, honestly, I'm completely 
lost on my own. Can you look up some info 
for me somehow!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Ohoh... Understood! I happen to be at a 
bookstore right now! Let's see, makeup 
books, makeup books... Found one!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Um, first you start with a base... 
Recommended cream... p-protec...? Whoaaa, 
there are so many!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Right...? I tried searching on a website 
earlier too, but I couldn't make heads or 
tails of it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... and of all times, nobody else is 
picking up their phones either...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Ah!? Sorry, Nature! It says skincare 
comes before base makeup! O-Ooooh... there 
are so many of these toooo!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so! That's a thing...?! There's 
a skincare section here, so maybe we can 
manage that part!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, this might be impossible. There are 
way too many skincare products. Even if we 
get past this, there's another wall 
waiting.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I do basic care myself, but... I 
don't use this and that and twenty other 
things like that.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Don't give up, Nature!! Hang on, Turbo 
just showed up, so I'll ask her!!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no, what help is Turbo gonna be 
when it comes to makeup, seriously?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(...Oh no. I overheard their 
conversation...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, I messed up... I went and asked her 
without giving it any thought...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(...Yet Nature-san is asking around, 
researching... and teaching me with all 
her heart, all for my sake.)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(She's doing all this just so she won't 
disappoint me, right?)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry to keep you waiting! Let's see, 
next up is, ummm...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(I want to become someone like that too. 
Someone gentle, warm... who can act while 
always considering the other person's 
feelings.)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Instead of what's trendy, let's find 
something that suits your skin, okay? No 
point pushing yourself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (Into a senior they can count on!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm so glad I decided to ask you, 
Nature-san!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Really? ...Hehe, you're making me blush, 
you know?
